turns.patient_opening: Hi. I’m a 20-year-old woman with metastatic cancer, and today I’m having severe chest pain—left side chest/breast pain and also right posterior chest wall pain that radiates. It started very fast and feels like haunting, violent, sharp pain, worse when I move and when I take a breath (pleuritic), and I have significant shortness of breath and a cough.

turns.doctor_question: Do your skin lesions peel off or flake away (for example, like skin shedding)?
turns.patient_answer: No, I don’t have skin lesions that peel or flake away.

turns.doctor_question: What color is the rash? (For example: red, pink, dark, pale, yellow—or is it absent?)
turns.patient_answer: I don’t have a rash—so there isn’t any rash color.
